root_cause.text: In raid10_read_request and raid10_write_request, when a NOWAIT request is rejected due to an active barrier, the code calls raid_end_bio_io() which unconditionally decrements conf->nr_pending via allow_barrier(), but the matching increment of nr_pending was never performed for NOWAIT requests, leading to nr_pending underflow and a deadlock of the resync thread.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states: "raid_end_bio_io() eventually calls allow_barrier() and it will unconditionally do an atomic_dec_and_test(&conf->nr_pending) even though the corresponding increment on nr_pending didn't happen in the NOWAIT case." The patch fixes this by replacing raid_end_bio_io() with free_r10bio() in both request paths, avoiding the erroneous decrement.

Therefore, the function does not contain the vulnerable pattern, and the bug is neither introduced nor fixed here.
